question: What status is attained by one endowed with the eleventh quality?
premises: The eleventh stage confers endowed qualities
Such a person becomes an object of worship
The worship is compared to worship of Shiva
inference: One endowed with the eleventh quality is worshipped as Shiva.
uncertainties: The exact nature of the eleven qualities is not specified
plain_english: Endowed with the eleventh quality, this one is worshipped just as Shiva is worshipped.
